\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bHi \PN. That was an amazing and strange World Cup, no?
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bThat "Agent 017" young boy, was defeating everyone.
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bBut after the Roud of 8, he simply left the Tournament, without any warning.
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bNobody knows why he did this...
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bAnyway...\nI closely watched your performance during the World Cup and could confirm that you are truly amazing.
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bHowever, you still have a lot to grow as a Trainer.
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bPlease come visit me in my laboratory in Pallet Town.\n I have something for you there.
\f[faceprofcarvalho]\bOh, I was almost forgoting, do you want to know the final results of the World Cup?
